page.overview:
What is Boin Archipelago?

The Boin Archipelago is a series of flower-shaped islands in Paradise. Usopp was sent to one of these islands by Bartholomew Kuma during the events of Sabaody Archipelago Arc.

One of the islands is home to the swindling forest of . Also, it is known to have a forest made of food, called the . Within it live various gigantic bugs and vicious man-eating plants. This forest not only includes ordinary wild food such as plum trees and corn stalks, but also a river of already prepared ramen. In the anime, this forest resembles a food-based theme park more than anything else. Although it's mentioned there are thieves in Greenstone, the only known residents so far have been Heracles and Usopp, who was sent there by Bartholomew Kuma from the Sabaody Archipelago and spent two years in the Boin Archipelago honing his skills to eventually reunite with his crew and face the challenges of the New World. It is said that anyone who enters this island has no chance of leaving it again, though both Usopp and Heracles managed the feat.

The islands are actually giant carnivorous plants scientifically known as "Stomach Baron", that eat overweight animals that are in the Greenstone forest. A group of giant beetles guards the edges.

The 'islands' host a large variety of unique plant species known as Pop Greens. According to Usopp, the further one delves into the islands, the greater the variant of Pop Greens one can find. However, since the further you go in, the more difficult it is to escape, it is not wise to do so.
